source_transitions.change: Only wide-panel method selection: skip previously measured slow SIMT controls and depths 2-3.

limitations: Panels, not a complete mining attempt; noise generation, uploads, root conversion, scratch allocation and proofs outside timing.
All 32 milestones, scattered XORs, rotate/XOR state, final BLAKE3 and zero-target check remain inside timing.
Larger correctness checks sample three tile XORs at each of the 32 milestones; exhaustive C/digest checks use the small validation panel.
Sequential method groups, normal boost and one idle external GPU process; no randomized/interleaved ordering or dynamic performance counters.
Prototypes materialize C/state, use simple GEMM leaves, recompute B transforms and conservative interval bounds.
SIMT and deeper recursion were not timed on the widest panel; they were timed on both smaller panels.
No successful Compute Sanitizer instrumentation or RTX 3090 validation is claimed.
